subject: Marketplace enablement: DataWeave listing + co-sell wiring
messages:
From: Anika Rao <anika@dataweave.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Request: DataWeave listing + co-sell tagging (AWS/GCP)

Hi Marcus —

Thanks again for taking the intro call yesterday. DataWeave builds a data-transformation layer that integrates with several LLM providers; we now have a customer-ready connector for Redwood and want to publish as a paid SaaS listing on AWS Marketplace and GCP Marketplace. High-level asks:

- Get Redwood listed as the preferred inference partner on our listing (co-sell tag + partner callout).
- Help accelerate AWS/GCP certification and provide the Redwood SKU mapping we need for integrated billing.
- Align on a mutual action plan to be co-sell ready in the next 6 weeks (target: Oct 31 GA).

I've attached a draft SKU mapping and our recent SOC2 snapshot for initial evidence. Can you loop in the right folks from your marketplace/partner ops and let us know the minimal evidence set for both clouds? Also, is there a Redwood partnership checklist we should follow?

Attachment: dataweave-sku-mapping.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: dw-soc2-snapshot.pdf (PDF)

Cheers,
Anika Rao
Head of Partnerships | DataWeave
https://dataweave.io
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Anika Rao <anika@dataweave.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: DataWeave listing + co-sell tagging (AWS/GCP)

Hi Anika —

Appreciate the materials and the ambition on timing. We can support co-sell tagging and provide SKU mapping, but there are a few tracks to run in parallel:

1) Marketplace evidence: our partner ops team will need the SOC2 snapshot, a tech-runbook for onboarding, and a short security questionnaire answered. The SOC2 you sent is a good start; Priyom will follow up with the specific checklist items.

2) Billing & SKUs: we can map Redwood metering SKUs to your product SKUs — Ben, can you take point on the SKU mapping and confirm any constraints for AWS vs GCP?

3) Co-sell logistics: Lauren, can you scope what co-sell collateral + one-pager we'd need to pitch to field teams and AWS/GCP partner leads?

Suggested next steps:
- Priyom: send the Redwood partner evidence template by EOD Fri (Sep 25).
- Ben: review attached SKU mapping and highlight missing fields by Tue Sep 28.
- Anika: please fill the mutual-action-plan template (I've copied a Drive link below) and we can do a 30-min ops sync next week.

Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/Shared/DataWeave/MAP

I'll also introduce you to our marketplace partner contact at AWS after Priyom confirms the evidence scope.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Head of Channel Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Anika Rao <anika@dataweave.io>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: DataWeave listing + co-sell tagging (AWS/GCP)

Hi team —

I reviewed dataweave-sku-mapping.xlsx. A few notes:

- We need explicit product tier mapping (e.g., DW Basic / DW Pro) to Redwood metering dimensions; right now file lists only plan names.
- For AWS Marketplace, consolidated billing requires a monthly usage record that aligns to our SKU id — I can provide a sample CSV schema.
- GCP has a different entitlements flow; we'll need a GCP-specific SKU column and a short integration test (we can schedule a test account).

Questions for Anika:
1) Do you have plan-level pricing (USD) per unit and any trial/credit model?
2) Is DataWeave planning private offers or public marketplace listing?

I've attached a sample CSV template in the Drive MAP folder — will upload tonight.

–Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Partner Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Anika Rao <anika@dataweave.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: DataWeave Legal <legal@dataweave.io>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: DataWeave listing + co-sell tagging (AWS/GCP)

Ben, Marcus —

Thanks for the quick reviews. Answers below and I've uploaded an updated MAP doc to the Drive link you shared.

1) Pricing and plans: we have 3 plans (Starter, Scale, Enterprise). Price points (USD/monthly list): Starter $199, Scale $899, Enterprise custom. We plan to launch with public listing + private offers for large customers.

2) Plan-level mapping: attached the updated SKU spreadsheet with plan columns and sample usage_unit definitions.

3) Evidence: legal has attached our standard marketplace agreement template (for Redwood review). We can provide a short runbook and test credentials for a staging integration next week.

Attachments uploaded to Drive: mutual-action-plan-dw.docx

If that works, can we lock a 30-min ops sync for Thu Sep 30 at 10:00am PT? That would let us close the MAP and get AWS/GCP partner favorability conversations scheduled.

Best,
Anika
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Anika Rao <anika@dataweave.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 16:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: DataWeave listing + co-sell tagging (AWS/GCP)

Perfect — thanks Anika and team. Confirming next steps we agreed on the call and via thread:

- Thu 2026-09-30 10:00am PT: ops sync (30 min) to finalize MAP and evidence checklist. Invite to follow from Priyom.
- Ben: will upload SKU CSV schema and a short primer for AWS vs GCP billing integration before the sync.
- Priyom: will share Redwood partner evidence template + security questionnaire by EOD Sep 30.
- Lauren: will draft a 1-pager co-sell play and initial one-slide field pitch for AWS/GCP seller-facing teams (target: Oct 6).
- Anika: please have DataWeave legal review Redwood's standard partner MSA and add any redlines to the Drive doc.

If there are legal terms that could impact listing timing (e.g., data residency or indemnity clauses), flag them ahead of the sync so we can pull in our legal ops. Otherwise looks good — excited to get you listed and working with our field on co-sell motions.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Channel Partnerships | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0134
https://redwood.com/partners
